ship_or_resort_name: P&O Arvia + Hotel Riu Palace Tenerife 5* (Costa Adeje)
room_or_cabin_highlights: Deck 12 Mid-Ship Balcony Deluxe (Cabin B-12404 — unobstructed sea view, 30m to central lifts, gluten-free main dining)
veteran_tribal_tip: VETERAN TIP: Avoid Deck 8 cabins 8201-8245 on Arvia because the Promenade hot tubs and lifeboats overlook the balcony. Deck 12 Mid-Ship gives total privacy and easy lift access!
recommended_add_ons: Gatwick North Meet & Greet Parking (£98) + No1 Lounge (£76) + €1,200 Sunny Spend FX Card

room_or_cabin_highlights: Guaranteed Interconnecting Family Rooms (Pool View) + Caribbean Lagoon Splash Park + Nut-Free Kids Buffet
veteran_tribal_tip: VETERAN TIP: When families ask for Marbella, warn them Marbella beaches are stony and steep! Recommend Torremolinos (Playamar) here instead—flat promenade, wide soft sand, and direct beach access.
recommended_add_ons: Gatwick Family Fast-Track + Meet & Greet Parking (£115) + €800 Sunny Spend FX Card

room_or_cabin_highlights: Full Accessible Balcony Cabin (Deck 11 Mid-Ship — 72cm wide automatic doorway, roll-in wet room with grab rails, turning circle for mobility scooter)
veteran_tribal_tip: VETERAN TIP: Standard cabins on Iona only have a 58cm bathroom step-up doorway—always book designated Accessible Deck 11 Mid-Ship cabins for mobility scooters and pre-book Olden step-free Briksdal coaching.
recommended_add_ons: CPS Southampton Valet Port Parking (£105) + NOK/EUR Sunny Spend Card

room_or_cabin_highlights: Deluxe Two-Bedroom Family Bungalow Suite with Swim-Up Pool & Private Beach Childcare
veteran_tribal_tip: VETERAN TIP: Book the Dine-Out local restaurant programme at the same time as the room—it is included free in Deluxe All-Inclusive and sells out 6 weeks before departure.
recommended_add_ons: Heathrow T5 Plaza Premium Lounge (£110) + Private Mercedes Transfer + €1,500 Sunny Spend FX

room_or_cabin_highlights: Preferred Club Ocean-View Swim-Up Suite + Heated Outdoor Pools + Late A-La-Carte Dining
veteran_tribal_tip: VETERAN TIP: Playa Blanca in the south is sheltered from the northern trade winds in November–February, making it 3–4°C warmer by the pool than Costa Teguise.
recommended_add_ons: Gatwick North Lounge (£72) + €750 Sunny Spend FX Card
